Interface SurrenderPolicy

All Known Implementing Classes:
EnabledSurrenderPolicy, NoSurrenderPolicy
public interface SurrenderPolicy
Interface representing the surrender policy in the game. It defines methods to check if surrender is enabled, request surrender, confirm surrender, and retrieve surrendered ships.
